title: With high probability the random subgraph admits no small Tutte obstruction in the whole window of edge probabilities
author: Sahar Diskin, Anna Geisler
work: \vspace{-1.5cm}Perfect Matching in Product Graphs\\ and in their Random Subgraphs
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the size bound for small Tutte obstructions in the whole window of edge probabilities (author lemma at source lines 671-673, label lem:no-small-tutte). The proof (source lines 1039-1053) is the author's own explicit Proof of lem:no-small-tutte, and it consumes the two structural lemmas of the surrounding subsection: the minimality lemma on the components met by every vertex of an obstruction and the two counting lemmas on sets with a small boundary. The argument is what makes the random part of the paper's main theorem uniform in p over the window, which the author stresses in the statement. H2.
